payload.label: SKP team notes
payload.description: Produce a findings note from approved Story intake, then review and finish it without code conformance.

skills.description: Produce an inert note from approved Story intake
skills.instructions: Read the exact approved intake artifact. Produce only the selected Markdown findings artifact. State observations, uncertainties, and source references. Do not read or modify application source, invoke external tools, publish, submit, or approve. Stop for human review.

agents.description: Write one reviewed team note from approved intake
agents.prompt: Use only the exact approved intake supplied to this phase. Produce the selected findings note, identify uncertainty, and stop for human review. Never publish or approve.

agents.description: Compare the team note to approved intake for human disposition
agents.prompt: Read the exact approved intake and team note. Produce only the selected review record: identify supported findings, gaps, and questions for the human approver. Do not read application source, publish, or approve.

templates.label: Team note review record
templates.content:
